newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Financial completes note purchase.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Financial completes note purchase.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Wednesday that holders of about 95.3 percent of the company's 13 percent senior notes due 2000 accepted a purchase offer.
Holders of $138,139,000, or about 95.3 percent, of all of the company's 13 percent senior notes due 2000 accepted the company's offer to purchase, Olympic said in a statement.
Olympic Financial is a consumer finance company which buys, sells and services retail installment contracts for new and used automobiles originated by more than 7,700 dealers nationwide.
